name: 动物行为学与行为神经科学预设
description: 专注于本能定型动作与习得行为、社会通讯与优势层级、求偶交配、觅食防御、认知学习以及神经内分泌驱动机制。
en_description: Comprehensive ethological ontology covering innate motor displays, learned behaviors, social communication, courtship, foraging, learning, and neuroendocrine drivers.

Behavior_Pattern.name: 行为模式 / 动作表型 / 行为谱项
Behavior_Pattern.label: 行为模式 / 动作表型 / 行为谱项
Behavior_Pattern.description: 定型动作模式 (FAP)、觅食、求偶舞蹈、进攻、逃避、梳理、巡视、育幼等行为动作与表型
Behavior_Pattern.en_description: Fixed action patterns (FAPs), foraging, courtship dances, aggression, flight, grooming, and parental care behaviors.
patterns: .*(?:behavior|behaviour|display|grooming|foraging|courtship|copulation|parenting|vocalization|aggression|nesting|locomotion)$
.*(?:行为|动作|展示|修饰|梳理|觅食|求偶|交配|育幼|鸣叫|发声|攻击|筑巢|迁移|漫游|休眠)$
^(?:fixed action pattern|fap|mating dance|tail wagging|head bobbing|fleeing|freezing|threat display|submission|alarm call|social play)$
^(?:定型动作模式|求偶舞蹈|摆尾|点头展示|逃跑|僵直不动|假死|威吓姿态|屈服姿态|报警鸣叫|社交游戏)$

Stimulus_Releaser.name: 环境刺激 / 释放元 / 信号线索
Stimulus_Releaser.label: 环境刺激 / 释放元 / 信号线索
Stimulus_Releaser.description: 引发本能或习得反应的关键符号刺激、释放元、性信息素、报警鸣声、视觉斑块及环境线索
Stimulus_Releaser.en_description: Sign stimuli, releasers, sexual/alarm pheromones, auditory alarms, visual patches, and environmental cues.
patterns: .*(?:stimulus|releaser|pheromone|cue|signal|odorant|scent)$
.*(?:刺激|释放元|符号刺激|信息素|费洛蒙|线索|信号|气味标记|鸣声标记)$
^(?:sign stimulus|supernormal stimulus|alarm pheromone|sex pheromone|trail pheromone|visual cue|auditory cue|tactile cue|chemical marker)$
^(?:关键刺激|超常刺激|报警信息素|性信息素|示踪信息素|视觉线索|听觉线索|触觉线索|化学标记)$

Neuroendocrine_Driver.name: 神经内分泌驱动 / 脑区回路 / 激素递质
Neuroendocrine_Driver.label: 神经内分泌驱动 / 脑区回路 / 激素递质
Neuroendocrine_Driver.description: 驱动特定行为动机与情绪的脑区核团、神经回路、神经肽、神经递质（多巴胺、五羟色胺）及循环激素（睾酮、催产素、皮质酮）
Neuroendocrine_Driver.en_description: Neural circuits, brain nuclei, neurotransmitters (dopamine, serotonin), neuropeptides, and hormones (oxytocin, testosterone, corticosterone).
patterns: .*(?:corticosterone|cortisol|testosterone|estrogen|oxytocin|vasopressin|prolactin|dopamine|serotonin|neuropeptide)$
.*(?:皮质酮|皮质醇|睾酮|雌二醇|催产素|加压素|催乳素|多巴胺|五羟色胺|血清素|神经肽|神经回路|脑区|核团)$
^(?:amygdala|hypothalamus|hippocampus|vta|nucleus accumbens|prefrontal cortex|pvn|bnst|da|5-ht|gaba|glutamate|ach|crf|crh|npy|octopamine)$
^(?:杏仁核|下丘脑|海马|腹侧被盖区|伏隔核|前额叶皮层|室旁核|终纹床核|多巴胺|五羟色胺|催产素|章鱼胺)$

Social_Structure_Role.name: 社会结构 / 群体层级 / 个体品级
Social_Structure_Role.label: 社会结构 / 群体层级 / 个体品级
Social_Structure_Role.description: 优势等级（首领α/从属β）、领地占有者、工蚁/兵蚁/蜂王品级、婚配体制（一夫一妻/一夫多妻）及社群网络
Social_Structure_Role.en_description: Dominance hierarchies (alpha/beta), territorial owners, social castes (worker/queen), and mating systems.
patterns: .*(?:hierarchy|dominance|subordinate|caste|monogamy|polygamy|polyandry|eusociality|territory)$
.*(?:社会层级|优势等级|首领|从属者|品级|一夫一妻制|一夫多妻制|一妻多夫制|真社会性|领地|领域|群落规模)$
^(?:alpha male|alpha female|dominant|subordinate|breeder|helper|worker|soldier|queen|scout|floater|harem)$
^(?:首领雄性|首领雌性|优势个体|从属个体|繁殖者|帮手|工蚁|兵蚁|蜂后|侦察兵|游荡个体|后宫)$

Cognitive_Learning_State.name: 认知状态 / 学习记忆 / 动机情绪
Cognitive_Learning_State.label: 认知状态 / 学习记忆 / 动机情绪
Cognitive_Learning_State.description: 经典与操作性条件反射、亲子印记、空间认知地图、恐惧记忆、奖赏预期、饥渴求取及焦虑应激状态
Cognitive_Learning_State.en_description: Classical/operant conditioning, imprinting, cognitive maps, fear memory, reward expectation, and affective states.
patterns: .*(?:learning|memory|conditioning|imprinting|habituation|sensitization|motivation|anxiety|stress)$
.*(?:学习|记忆|条件反射|印记|习惯化|敏感化|动机|焦虑|恐惧|应激|空间认知|认知地图)$
^(?:classical conditioning|operant conditioning|filial imprinting|spatial learning|habituation|sensitization|associative learning|working memory|fear conditioning|reward expectation)$
^(?:经典条件反射|操作条件反射|亲子印记|空间学习|习惯化|敏感化|联想学习|工作记忆|恐惧条件化|奖赏预期)$

Adaptive_Tradeoff.name: 适应性权衡 / 进化收益 / 适合度
Adaptive_Tradeoff.label: 适应性权衡 / 进化收益 / 适合度
Adaptive_Tradeoff.description: 最优觅食理论、捕食风险回避、亲代抚育投资、性选择成本、汉密尔顿法则亲缘选择及广义适合度
Adaptive_Tradeoff.en_description: Optimal foraging trade-offs, predation risk, parental investment, sexual selection costs, and inclusive fitness.
patterns: .*(?:tradeoff|trade-off|fitness|investment|sexual selection|kin selection|optimal foraging)$
.*(?:权衡|适应度|亲代投资|性选择|亲缘选择|最优觅食|博弈论|进化稳定策略)$
^(?:optimal foraging theory|oft|predation risk|parental investment|hamiltons rule|inclusive fitness|evolutionary stable strategy|ess|giving up density|gud)$
^(?:最优觅食理论|捕食风险|亲代投资|汉密尔顿法则|广义适合度|进化稳定策略|放弃密度)$

Uncertain.name: 待定 / 无法判断
Uncertain.label: 待定 / 无法判断
Uncertain.description: 证据不充分或未命中的行为学概念与实体
Uncertain.en_description: Ethological entities with ambiguous context or pending escalation analysis.

Stimulus_Elicitation.name: 刺激释放 / 行为触发
Stimulus_Elicitation.label: 刺激释放 / 行为触发
Stimulus_Elicitation.description: 外界关键符号刺激或释放元直接触发本能动作模式或反射行为
Stimulus_Elicitation.en_description: Sign stimulus or environmental releaser directly triggering innate or instinctive behavioral displays.

Neuroendocrine_Modulation.name: 神经内分泌调控 / 动机激活
Neuroendocrine_Modulation.label: 神经内分泌调控 / 动机激活
Neuroendocrine_Modulation.description: 激素、神经肽或神经递质对特定行为动机、侵略性、母性或焦虑水平的生理调节
Neuroendocrine_Modulation.en_description: Hormones, neuropeptides, or brain circuits modulating behavioral thresholds, motivation, and emotional arousal.

Social_Communication.name: 社群沟通 / 信号交互 / 威吓屈服
Social_Communication.label: 社群沟通 / 信号交互 / 威吓屈服
Social_Communication.description: 个体间通过鸣叫、舞蹈、气味标记或肢体姿态传递信息、威吓竞争者或表达臣服
Social_Communication.en_description: Inter-individual communication via vocalization, display, scent marking, or agonistic threat and submission.

Reinforcement_Learning.name: 奖赏强化 / 惩罚消退 / 条件反射建立
Reinforcement_Learning.label: 奖赏强化 / 惩罚消退 / 条件反射建立
Reinforcement_Learning.description: 奖赏反馈正强化行为反应，或厌恶刺激惩罚导致行为反应消退抑制
Reinforcement_Learning.en_description: Positive reward reinforcing behavioral occurrence, or aversive stimulus inducing extinction and avoidance.

Behavioral_Tradeoff.name: 行为权衡 / 相互拮抗 / 互斥分配
Behavioral_Tradeoff.label: 行为权衡 / 相互拮抗 / 互斥分配
Behavioral_Tradeoff.description: 警惕警戒与进食觅食、求偶炫耀与防捕食风险、自身生存与亲代投资之间的互斥权衡
Behavioral_Tradeoff.en_description: Mutual behavioral exclusion and resource allocation trade-offs (e.g., vigilance vs foraging, mating vs predation risk).

Reproductive_Selection.name: 求偶选择 / 配对交配 / 亲代抚育
Reproductive_Selection.label: 求偶选择 / 配对交配 / 亲代抚育
Reproductive_Selection.description: 雌性择偶偏好、雄性竞争炫耀、交配繁殖行为以及对子代的孵化喂养亲代投资
Reproductive_Selection.en_description: Mate choice preference, male display competition, copulation, and offspring parental investment.

Hierarchical_Dominance.name: 优势支配 / 从属从属 / 社群组成
Hierarchical_Dominance.label: 优势支配 / 从属从属 / 社群组成
Hierarchical_Dominance.description: 群体内部基于等级序位的攻击支配与屈从关系，或蜂群/蚁群品级社会分工组成
Hierarchical_Dominance.en_description: Dominance hierarchy establishment, subordinate submission, or division of labor within social groups.
